ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity black pigmentation with localized high-intensity white clusters; estimated ratio of 92:8 black to white pixels on visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black contiguous pigmentation across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast white geometric blobs localized on the distal tips (left and right) and sparse, irregular white mottling on the right lobe upper-medial region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an internal pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees and a bounding box depth roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (3-7 pixel variance) visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, appearing as a jagged silhouette against the sky/water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concave curvature from the lateral tips leading inward toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular white pixel groupings located on the distal ends of both fluke lobes, characterized by high-contrast edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions detected on the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white encrustations on the distal tips and margins consistent with parasitic or commensal organism attachment sites; multiple white scratch marks on the mid-right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A pinniped (sea lion) head is visible in the lower-left foreground quadrant, distinct from the whale fluke pixels.
